description: This file contains unit tests for the tenantClient utility functions, verifying their behavior in handling tenant ID normalization, fetching session tenants, selecting tenants, and updating localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant identifier formats into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches the list of session tenants from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates the server, and mirrors the selection in localStorage.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in localStorage and removes any legacy key.
